fusions.name: Closing Mesh
fusions.desc: Throws out a net that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand Spray
fusions.desc: Spits a strand that deals 3 damage, then snags 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage each.

fusions.name: Dragnet Croak
fusions.desc: A croak that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. An escort of water fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Threads
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a ward that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
